correctness.rationale: This counts distinct overlapping multiplicity-preserving trigram profiles of linear binary words after exactly one deletion, including both ends. Subtraction of the original profile is injective. Recounting the 32 five-bit contexts gives ten distinct interior deltas with multiplicities 8,8,4,4,2,2,1,1,1,1; the first and last two deletions contribute at most four additional deltas, giving 14. The fixed first four and last four bits of the witness give four distinct non-interior deltas. In the witness, 01000 uses the first three zeros of the extended run, 00100 its final two zeros plus 100, and 01001 its final zero plus 1001. The other seven required factors occur entirely in the fixed suffix. This corrects the misplaced location of 01001 in the proof text, not the claim or witness. For n<=3 all profiles are zero. For 4<=n<=20 the DP legitimately remembers the prefix, suffix, and exact set of interior deltas and covers every word. Independently ran python3 /workspace/review_evidence/recompute5.py in bounded slices 1–14, 15–17, and 18–20: each descendant was reconstructed and all its triple counts tallied from scratch in eight separate five-bit lanes (no carries because n-3<=17). Complementation permutes coordinates, so one leading-bit class is exhaustive modulo that invariant. The exact maxima were 1,1,1,4,4,6,6,7,8,8,9,10,10,10,11,12,12,12,13,14, with 48 extremizers at length 19 and 32 at length 20. The infinite claim rests on the verified contexts in the witness, not the finite run.
